Зеркало GitHub API должно быть доверенны: The GitHub API mirror must be trusted: it chooses which llama.cpp and OpenCode builds to install and reports their checksums (the files themselves are downloaded only from github.com/…/releases/download/ or via the github.com mirror). Models are verified by SHA-256 from the catalog. The proxy applies immediately, to new connections.

Срок действия удалённого каталога моделе: The remote model catalog expired on {0} — it is not applied.
